wiki.title: Robert Sampson (politician)
wiki.extract: Robert Charles Sampson (born August 28, 1969) is an American politician from Connecticut. A member of the Republican Party, he was first elected in 2010 to the Connecticut House of Representatives from the 80th House district, serving four terms (2011–2018). Since 2019, he has been a member of the Connecticut State Senate, elected from the 16th Senate District.
